Title: Cyréna Solution Architecture Overview
Content:
## Solution: Cyréna (Cyrena_App)
**Purpose**: An extensible AI assistant application framework built on .NET 10 with Blazor UI and Semantic Kernel.

### Project Structure (13 projects)
1. **Cyrena** (root Blazor lib) - Main entry point, wires everything together
2. **Cyrena.Core** (class lib) - Core contracts, models, options, builders
3. **Cyrena.Components.Core** (Blazor lib) - Shared Blazor components, UI contracts
4. **Cyrena.Components.Runtime** (Blazor lib) - UI runtime services (DisplayService, etc.)
5. **Cyrena.Runtime** (class lib) - Core runtime services (KernelController, ChatMessageService, etc.)
6. **Cyrena.Runtime.Ollama** (Blazor lib) - Ollama LLM connector
7. **Cyrena.Runtime.OpenAI** (Blazor lib) - OpenAI LLM connector
8. **Cyrena.Extensa.Core** (class lib) - Extension system contracts
9. **Cyrena.Extensa.Runtime** (class lib) - Extension loader, registry, installer
10. **Cyrena.Extensa.Components** (Blazor lib) - Extension marketplace UI
11. **Cyrena.Persistence.Core** (class lib) - Persistence abstractions (IStore)
12. **Cyrena.Persistence.File** (class lib) - File-based persistence implementation
13. **Cyrena.Tavily** (Blazor lib) - Tavily web search plugin (external extension example)

### Key Architectural Patterns
- **Plugin Architecture**: IAssistantMode + IAssistantPlugin for AI behavior
- **Extension System (Extensa)**: Dynamic loading of DLL extensions with dependency resolution
- **Builder Pattern**: CyrenaBuilder for DI configuration, CyrenaKernelBuilder per-chat kernel setup
- **Event Pipeline**: Custom EventPipeline for pub/sub within kernel-scoped services
- **Persistence**: IStore<T> abstraction with file-based JSON implementation
- **Connection Providers**: IConnectionProvider for LLM backends (Ollama, OpenAI)

### Version
Current: 0.4.0 / 0.4.1
